prompt: He aha te tikanga o te kupu 'kaitiakitanga'?

response.response_text:
Ko te kaitiakitanga te tiaki me te manaaki i te taiao, ā, i ahu mai i te tirohanga Māori ki te ao [[1]](cite://1/1). Ko te kupu *tiaki* te pūtake o te kupu nei, ā, ko tōna tikanga he tiaki, he pupuri, he manaaki, he whakaruru hoki [[2]](cite://2/1). Ko te kaitiaki he tangata, he rōpū rānei e mōhiotia ana e te tangata whenua hei kaitiaki mō tētahi wāhi, pērā i te roto, i te ngahere rānei [[3]](cite://3/1). I tipu mai te kaitiakitanga i te hononga hohonu o te tangata ki te whenua me te ao tūroa [[4]](cite://4/1).
